compatibility.summary: Approved server 0.26.0/player 0.12.0 milestone includes optional split cards and current-series statistics. Manifest schemas 1-5, snapshots, sync, and update contracts are unchanged. Older data-capable players retain classic values; older card players ignore statistics. New players accept older publications; downgrade saves require removing unsupported card/showStats settings. Full 231 Node, 97 Python, 33 Android JVM tests, three Chromium regressions, clean dependency install/audits, and isolated AMD64 container persistence/restore checks pass. Physical Onn/Pi acceptance remains outstanding.
